query: select c.name as "Court:Link/Court:120", c.sports_facility as "Facility:Link/Sports Facility:160", count(fb.name) as "Bookings:Int:100", coalesce(sum(timestampdiff(minute, fb.start_time, fb.end_time)), 0)/60 as "Booked Hours:Float:110" from `tabCourt` c left join `tabFacility Booking` fb on fb.court = c.name and fb.booking_status not in ('Cancelled', 'No-show') group by c.name order by c.name
